The absolute threshold is defined as the minimum stimulus intensity detected 50% of the time.  
At 80% power, 20 out of 30 mice responded (67%).  
At 70% power, 15 out of 30 mice responded (50%).  
At 60% power, 10 out of 30 mice responded (33%).  

Since 50% response rate occurs at 70% power, that is the absolute threshold.  

Final answer: (B)
